There will also be the opportunity to renew the contract for two (2) separate three (3) years renewals, based solely on the College’s discretion. 3.3.3 The total contract term, if optional renewals are activated, may be up to a maximum of a eleven (11) years period.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Olds College of Agriculture & Technology is seeking a Learning Management System (LMS) Platform & Support. The scope is detailed in Section D – Scope of Work & Pricing Schedule (page 19, per Table of Contents on page 2), which includes requirements for LMS systems and support, with specific evaluation criteria in Section B (pages 16-17) such as company experience, staff/resources, proposed solution, pricing, and references. The work is structured around mandatory requirements (Section 7.1) and scored criteria (Section 7.2) for proposal evaluation.

pricing_structure.value: No numeric pricing scoring formula is provided. Pricing is evaluated as a scored criterion with a maximum of 40 points, based on the Total Cost of Proposal (see Section D - Pricing Schedule for breakdown). Pricing must be submitted in Canadian dollars, fixed for the entire 5-year term, and detailed in Schedule D - Scope of Work and Pricing Schedule. The pricing section of the proposal must include a breakdown of implementation costs and ongoing LMS licensing/support costs.

insurance_requirements.quote:
Comprehensive General Liability insurance in an amount of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000) inclusive per occurrence against third party claims for bodily injury, personal injury, and property damage (including loss of use thereof). Such insurance shall cover all operations of the insured and include, but not being limited to: products and completed operations liability, blanket written contractual liability, owners and contractors protective liability, owners and employees as additional insured, and
• Insurance on property of others on an “all risks” basis, including theft, and in an amount sufficient to cover such property in the Contractor’s care, custody and control.

references_required.quote: Proponents should provide three references, where their company has provided the goods and services similar to those outlined in this RFP, including: name and title; name of company; phone number and email address; types of goods and services provided; and duration and value of agreement.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote:
RFP Evaluations & product demos
September 10 - November 15, 2026

vendor_experience_required.value: No stated minimum years or project count. Required experience includes: providing LMS systems and support; support for the existing Moodle LMS (if applicable); experience working with post-secondary institutions, including those that utilize Ellucian Banner.
vendor_experience_required.quote: Proponents should provide the following information in their Proposals: a) a brief company history, including the length of time the company has been in business and the number of years providing the goods and services requested in this RFP; b) a copy of the Proponent’s organizational structure, reporting structure, number of employees, etc.; c) an outline of the Proponent’s experience in providing the goods and services set out in this RFP, including providing LMS systems and support; or support for the existing Moodle LMS (if applicable) d) the Proponent’s experience working with post-secondary institutions previously, including with institutions that utilize Ellucian Banner
